        # Clean up
        gsl.gsl_permutation_free(perm)
        gsl.gsl_permutation_free(read_perm)

    lu_matrix = [[data[i * n + j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    perm_list = [perm[i] for i in range(n)]

    ]

    B_data = (ctypes.c_double * (n * n))(*B.flatten().tolist())
